name: Driver Progression
description: The driver grows separately from the car. This component owns driver-only growth — cornering-style specializations, a focus meter built by clean driving and spent on demand — kept deliberately distinct from vehicle stats so that selling the car never sells the person, and a great driver in a beater still feels like one. XP arrives from progression.xp_leveling; what this component adds is deciding which driver skills that XP unlocks through progression.skills_tree, and crediting skill-relevant feats: banked drifts (progression.driftBanked) and completed laps (world.lapCompleted) are the moments that prove a cornering style, so they feed the focus meter rather than only the scoreboard. It does not own vehicle upgrades — parts are housing.garage_management's business — and it does not own what the world thinks of the driver; reputation tiers and their gates belong to social.street_rep_tiers. The focus meter is the genre's risk dial: spending focus sharpens steering response for a sector, so the driver's skill economy is spent at the wheel, not in a menu.

inputs.name: focusMax
inputs.description: Maximum held focus charges. A small cap keeps focus tactical — one perfect sector, spent once — instead of a hoarded win button.

inputs.name: focusPerCleanSector
inputs.description: Focus granted for a sector driven without collision or invalidated gates. Rewards the driving the genre wants to see rather than grinding.

inputs.name: corneringStyleOptions
inputs.description: Specialization branches in the driver skill tree. Each style re-weights which feats build focus fastest, so build identity shows up in how you drive, not just what you bought.

inputs.name: xpFromFeatsFraction
inputs.description: Share of driver XP sourced from feats (drifts, clean laps) versus gig payouts. Kept below half so progress still requires taking work, not just hot-lapping.

outputs.name: unlockedDriverSkills
outputs.description: Driver skill ids unlocked so far. Read by garage UI to preview 'you versus your car' and by HUD for focus availability.
